This document serves as a clearinghouse for nifty code chunks that might look complicated, but get a lot done.


``` r
library(otndata)
otn_login("act")
#> ✔ Login successful!
```

## Database operations on the fly

Plone does not allow you to stream data over HTTP, but you _can_ download files to a temporary directory and make some quick queries. Is this efficient? Maybe, maybe not. Here is an example: 


``` r
td <- file.path(tempdir(), "detections")
dir.create(td)

otn_list_projects("mine", network = "act") |>
  _$collectioncode |>
  lapply(otn_extract_files, text = "matched parquet", network = "act") |>
  do.call(rbind, args = _) |>
  otn_download(outdir = td)
#> ✔ 5 file(s) saved to ']8;;file:///tmp/RtmpX4D7Bo/detections/hudrsb_matched_detections.parquet/tmp/RtmpX4D7Bo/detections/hudrsb_matched_detections.parquet]8;;', ']8;;file:///tmp/RtmpX4D7Bo/detections/mdbsb_matched_detections.parquet/tmp/RtmpX4D7Bo/detections/mdbsb_matched_detections.parquet]8;;', ']8;;file:///tmp/RtmpX4D7Bo/detections/mdwea_matched_detections.parquet/tmp/RtmpX4D7Bo/detections/mdwea_matched_detections.parquet]8;;', ']8;;file:///tmp/RtmpX4D7Bo/detections/pasbt_matched_detections.parquet/tmp/RtmpX4D7Bo/detections/pasbt_matched_detections.parquet]8;;', and ']8;;file:///tmp/RtmpX4D7Bo/detections/paxsb08_matched_detections.parquet/tmp/RtmpX4D7Bo/detections/paxsb08_matched_detections.parquet]8;;'.

db <- arrow::open_dataset(td)
db |>
```

## `otndo` reports

Create reports for _all_ of my projects in one go. Right now, this needs to be done separately for receiver and tag projects. First, receiver projects:


``` r
# List my projects
otn_list_projects("mine") |>

  # Grab the collection code
  _$collectioncode |>

  # Create receiver summaries, wrapped in tryCatch as some projects are tag-only
  lapply(
    function(x) {
      tryCatch(
        otn_receiver_summary(x),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
    }
  )
```

Same thing for tag projects:


``` r
# List my projects
otn_list_projects("mine") |>

  # Grab the collection code
  _$collectioncode |>

  # Create tag summaries, wrapped in tryCatch as some projects are receiver-only
  lapply(
    function(x) {
      tryCatch(
        otn_tag_summary(x),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
    }
  )
```

## Multi-network users

List all of my extract files in parquet format projects across multiple networks.



``` r
c("act", "otn_devel") |>

  # List all of my projects
  lapply(
    function(.) otn_list_projects(what = "mine", network = .)
  ) |>
  do.call(rbind, args = _) |>

  # Pull out project codes
  _$collectioncode |>

  # Grab the parquet extract files. Wrapped in "tryCatch" in case some projects
  #    lack files
  lapply(
    function(x) {
      tryCatch(
        otn_extract_files(x, text = "parquet"),
        error = function(e) {
          NULL
        }
      )
    }
  ) |>
  do.call(rbind, args = _)
```
